components.note: compilation_unit.solc_version < '0.8.0' is a hardcoded literal match to this requirement's threshold. Evidence only, not a complete verdict, because of the unresolvable override component below.

The requirement's exception ('unless it meets all the following requirements from the EEA EthTrust Security Levels Specification Version 2, as Overriding Requirements') refers to a requirement set in a DIFFERENT spec document (V2) not present in our Phase 0 V3 snapshot. This component cannot be derived, mechanically or otherwise, without first acquiring and parsing that separate document -- explicitly out of scope for Track A. Marked AMBIGUOUS_TEXT_GAP rather than assumed satisfied or unsatisfiable, per the plan's 'zero invented catch-alls' rule -- we do not guess this component's outcome to make the overall requirement look complete.

aggregation_rule: applicability_state = APPLICABLE always (per L3, logical_scope_entailment on the unconditioned subject). conformance_state = FAIL if trigger-version-below-080 fires AND override-set-v2-spec-satisfied can be confirmed false or is unresolvable-and-treated-conservatively; PASS if trigger-version-below-080 does not fire; INCONCLUSIVE if trigger-version-below-080 fires and override-set-v2-spec-satisfied's status is AMBIGUOUS_TEXT_GAP (cannot rule the override in or out) -- chosen deliberately over a forced FAIL, since asserting FAIL would silently treat the unresolved override as never satisfied, which is itself an unsupported assumption this framework should not make quietly.
overall_status: PARTIAL_STRATEGY -- one DETERMINISTIC_EVIDENCE_ONLY component reusable now (Slither), one component blocked on out-of-scope V2 spec acquisition. Correctly surfaces INCONCLUSIVE rather than a false-confidence FAIL/PASS when the trigger fires.
